clues.desc: Ayaka's letter invited Mai to the storage room -- but a scaffolding tamperer normally lures their victim there, not the reverse, so Mai (the invitee) can't be the tamperer.

The seal toy left at the scene carries a coffee stain from the green room and is registered to Yuko's phone, while unsold display units can't be phone-controlled at all -- ties this specific, registered unit to Yuko.
The crane-stacked boxes on floor 2 require two people to build (one on the crane, one securing) -- proves a second person besides Ayaka was involved, ruling out Mai acting alone.
The Ayaka-Mai murder plot was a secret known only to Ayaka and Yuko -- only the other conspirator could have redirected the trap onto Ayaka herself.
